title: VIXEN kernel pin needs a manual override to pair the Undertow main-wave facade
body: Base configure failed PIPE005 because VIXEN's tracked kernel pin 6e3474325d55e14ebfc803c1b816fd805e4ac64c exposes the old two-argument Message facade while Undertow main-wave uses Message<SaveNever>(). The successful workaround was a per-build-tree VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE pointing at the compatible kernel checkout. Consolidate compatible consumer/kernel pairing or derive the required override automatically.

title: VIXEN CodegenTool cache emits a slashless analyzer-stamp path
body: VIXEN's generated cached build command passes --output <cache>/bin to SDFNodeGenerator.csproj, whose analyzer stamp concatenates bin + SDFNodeGenerator.dll and fails as <cache>/binSDFNodeGenerator.dll. The successful queued workaround was a direct CodegenTool build with --output <cache>/bin/ followed by the cache completion marker. Normalize the path in the facade or stamp tool.

title: Kernel full tests require manual UNDERTOW_ROOT when invoked directly
body: Direct queued dotnet test of the kernel SourceGenerator and CodegenTool suites failed because UndertowCheckout could not derive the paired consumer checkout without UNDERTOW_ROOT. The documented paired-root launcher supplies it, but direct suite invocations do not. Make the test entry point derive or inject the paired root consistently.

title: Queue breaker cannot distinguish repaired external cache input
body: After repairing the external VIXEN CodegenTool cache, rerunning the identical queued cmake --build gpu_systems_check command was refused as a reused failure. The successful workaround was --no-breaker. Include cache/provisioning input revisions in the queue identity or provide a documented repair-aware retry path.

title: Queue diagnostic parser drops clear schema-source lineage failures
body: The FrameTargets schema check emitted a complete RUNTIME FIELD LINEAGE REQUIRED message with what, where, why, remedy, and exact action, but the queued result classified it as diagnostic unavailable because the bounded parser did not recognize the generated schema-source line as a source-located diagnostic. Preserve the raw diagnostic as structured queue output.
